Argentina consumes the most beef per person in the cited 2024 comparison, at about 48.5 kg annually, according to [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/chicken-rules-roost-pinched-argentines-eat-less-pricey-beef-2025-01-27/). The size of a country’s burger industry does not establish its per-person beef consumption.

CONFIDENCE: 93
